body: cast protect/shell/haste/regen/refresh apply status.Effect to player statFX. cast dia deals 5 HP to combat target. WHM required (Refresh also allows RDM). Tick loop handles Regen/Refresh HP/MP recovery. All 6 spells build+test clean.
title: S111-01: WHM/RDM buff spells — Protect/Shell/Haste/Regen/Refresh/Dia
